Name: Simple Tool Delivery
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[heading]Simple Tool Delivery[/heading]
Less waiting and fewer trips to the blacksmith! Clint’s tool upgrades finish one day sooner, and your upgraded tool arrives in your farmhouse mailbox.

“Finished your tool ahead of schedule. Figured I'd save you the trip. —Clint”

[size=4]Features[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Faster upgrades:[/b] Give Clint your tool today and receive it tomorrow morning.[/*]
[*][b]Delivered to your door:[/b] Open Clint’s letter and click the attached tool to collect it.[/*]
[*][b]Trash cans included:[/b] Upgrades apply automatically when ready, with a confirmation letter.[/*]
[*][b]Preserves your tool:[/b] Keeps enchantments, attachments, and custom tool data.[/*]
[*][b]Collect whenever you’re ready:[/b] Full backpack? Your tool stays safe until you have room.[/*]
[*][b]Same upgrade costs:[/b] Prices and material requirements remain unchanged.[/*]
[/list][size=4]Compatibility[/size]
Clint’s dialogue, portraits, and schedule are untouched, so the mod is designed to work alongside dialogue and portrait mods.
Mods that also change upgrade timing or tool delivery may overlap. Custom tools using a separate upgrade system may not be supported.
[size=4]
Installation[/size]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b].
Extract the download into your [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch through SMAPI. Works with existing saves—no configuration needed!
